title: SearchIntent
description: Provider-neutral generic-search intent. display_limit is a finite visible maximum, not an acquisition count. Supported values include 1, 3, 5, and 10. Current GUI may still expose 1/3/5 until Implementation PR A lands.

original_user_query.description: Normalized user intent retained for display and provenance.

display_limit.description: Maximum usable listings displayed per selected provider. Not acquisition_budget and not acquisition_requested.

generation.description: Stale-response guard. A result owns the generation that produced it.

scope.description: Requested geographic scope for that provider, or null when not applicable.
